root_cause: macOS overlay used alwaysOnTopLevel=floating (below League) and could show before League bounds resolved, so the panel appeared tied to the RiftLens Space/z-order.

before.note: floating sits below Dock / Metal game windows on macOS

permission_guidance: If League bounds cannot be read, grant Screen Recording or Accessibility for RiftLens, keep Windowed/Borderless, then Recheck.
